title: Apply for a farm firefighting vehicle registration
summary: Learn about and apply for conditional registration for a farm firefighting vehicle or trailer for emergency use.
intro:
Your dedicated farm firefighting vehicle or trailer may be eligible for conditional registration.

Farm firefighting vehicle registration is for emergency use only. If you plan to use your vehicle more regularly, consider applying for standard vehicle registration.
who_can_apply: The vehicle must be for emergency use (farm firefighting).
what_you_need: Proof of registration entitlement (statutory declarations are acceptable)
The PDF form: 'Application for Conditional Registration'

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete Application for Conditional Registration – PDF.
Make sure you have the required inspection report.
Visit a service centre and submit your application with payment.

internal_links.text: Change the details on a conditional vehicle registration

faqs.q: Is this registration for regular use?
faqs.a: No, farm firefighting vehicle registration is for emergency use only. If you plan to use your vehicle more regularly, you should consider applying for standard vehicle registration.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for conditional registration?
faqs.a: You need an inspection report, proof of identity, vehicle registration details, proof of registration entitlement, fee payment, and the 'Application for Conditional Registration' PDF form.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application?
faqs.a: First, download and complete the 'Application for Conditional Registration' PDF. Then, ensure you have the required inspection report. Finally, visit a service centre to submit your application with payment.
